THE BRAND 0 4CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL ORIGIN OF THE BRAND Source: Behance, Octagon SS23, 2023 0 4 Our Story Invisible String Theory. We b0nd was born from the vision to uncover the invisible connections that link us within our social spheres. Our goal is to create a space where these bonds can flourish, cultivating genuine relationships that align with each member's identity and values. The Problem We’ve built social networks of people we barely know. Gen-Z’s most utilized social media platforms are crowded with acquaintances and strangers—most of whom we’ll never meet in real life—creating a superficial digital space with little intention, making true, in-person connections harder to build. The Solution We b0nd: Your Circle Extended. We b0nd connects you with individuals you naturally resonate with—friends of friends you haven't met yet but are meant to. We provide access to a digital third space, anytime and anywhere in the world, ensuring every new connection starts with someone you already know. THE BRAND 0 5CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL MISSION VISION Our mission is to create a trusted social network that leverages the power of mutual connections. We bring to light the relationships that have always existed, facilitating authentic connections that foster a sense of belonging. We b0nd envisions a world where every meaningful connection is within reach. Our goal is to make these connections visible, enabling individuals to navigate their social networks with ease and nurture relationships that enhance their lives, no matter where they are in the world. THE BRAND 0 6CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL VALUES 1 2 3 4 Trust Serendipity Selective Engagement Excellence Serendipity uncovers hidden bonds, helping individuals discover connections they were always meant to find. Excellence reflects a commitment to quality, ensuring that every interaction is designed to foster meaningful connections within an authentic environment. Selective engagement thrives in a third space where members feel they are in the right place, surrounded by the right people. It prioritizes meaningful interactions over quantity, aligned with shared values and enhancing personal growth. Trust is built through existing, vetted relationships, creating a secure environment that encourages open engagement and makes exploring new connections easier. THE BRAND 0 7CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL THE BRAND UNIQUE SELLING PROPOSITION Source: Deep tech Magazine, 2023 We unlock the potential within your existing social circle rather than connecting you with strangers. Our philosophy is simple: You Always Have a Friend in Common. We enable you to expand your network with confidence by starting from trusted connections, ensuring that every introduction comes with an inherent level of trust. Because, a friend of a friend is, in essence, your friend too. “ If You Can Trust your Friends, You Can Trust Us” THE BRAND 0 8CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL NAMING Te naming of our brand was a deliberate choice that reflects our mission. "We b0nd" encapsulates the essence of our platform— harnessing the power of connections, aligning the right individuals at the right time and in the right context. . The name draws inspiration from the strength of atomic bonds, emphasizing the significance of relationships. The substitution of the letter "o" with the digit "0" adds a modern flair, signaling our innovative approach in today's tech-driven landscape and enhancing the name's visual appeal. The name carries a sophisticated resonance, reminiscent of the elegance associated with James Bond and the exclusivity of elite locales like Zero Bond in NYC. LOGO 11CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL LOGOTYPE The primary logo features the elegant wordmark "We b0nd," crafted in a refined serif typeface. Its standout design incorporates the letter "0" in striking red, serving as a visual focal point that symbolizes unity and the ongoing expansion of one's social circle. This distinctive treatment of the "0" infuses the logo with sophistication and exclusivity, mirroring the brand's mission to cultivate meaningful connections in a polished and refined way. The overall aesthetic balances modernity with timeless elegance, where the contrast of black text against the vibrant red conveys a sense of luxury. Beneath the wordmark, the tagline "Your Circle, Extended" is subtly placed, reinforcing the brand's dedication to expanding social networks through trusted relationships. This logo will be consistently used across digital platforms, promotional merchandise, and event materials, ensuring strong brand representation and recognition. LOGO1 2CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL LOGO ICON The icon for We.b0nd features concentric circles, symbolizing the expansion of one’s social network. The minimalist design reflects the brand's focus on connection and growth, visually emphasizing the concept of "Your Circle, Extended." The icon’s subtle tilt is a nod to the sleek, dynamic energy of James Bond, subconsciously evoking a sense of coolness and exclusivity. This design element reinforces the brand's appeal to those seeking to connect with a sophisticated and similar social circle. 1 3CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL LOGO MINIMIUM SIZE Print: 25mm Digital: 75px Print: 15mm Digital: 100px When determining the minimum size for a logo, it is essential to consider its application to both print and digital platforms . The logo is adaptable and can be used with different color backgrounds as black and white are timeless and versatile colors. 1 8CORPORATE IDENTITY MANUAL COLOURS The crimson red (#AB3130) selected for We b0nd embodies warmth and vitality, symbolizing trust and the meaningful connections our platform nurtures. This vibrant hue establishes an environment where belonging flourishes and reinforces our role as an elegant connector within your extended social circle. In contrast, the warm beige shade (#F3E7DE) promotes a sophisticated yet inviting atmosphere, instilling calm and comfort that allows members to feel at home. When paired with the deep black, this combination enhances a sense of exclusivity and refinement, emphasizing the distinctive nature of our platform. Together, these colors create a space where authentic relationships can thrive, fostering an environment where meaningful connections are nurtured.
